surfaces.label: Skill Runtime
surfaces.activationRule: Load relevant skills before implementation or tool-heavy planning.
guardrails: skill guidance does not override explicit user constraints

surfaces.label: Local Development Tools
surfaces.activationRule: Use for repo edits, validation, manifests, and commits inside the canonical iCloud workspace.
guardrails: require explicit confirmation for destructive operations
run focused checks before broad quality

surfaces.label: Node REPL And Browser Automation
surfaces.activationRule: Use for local browser inspection, screenshots, and interactive UI verification when a web surface changes.

surfaces.label: GitHub Governance Connectors
surfaces.activationRule: Use after publish-readiness verifies branch, sync, auth, workflow scope, and transport; never push directly to main.
guardrails: report local vs remote state separately

surfaces.label: Design Collaboration Connectors
surfaces.activationRule: Use when the mission creates, reviews, or syncs a design artifact.
guardrails: reuse design systems before creating new components
avoid design writes without target context

surfaces.label: Documentation And Knowledge MCPs
surfaces.activationRule: Use for current or primary documentation when local knowledge is insufficient.

surfaces.label: Cloud Infrastructure MCPs
surfaces.activationRule: Use only after target environment, cost boundary, secret policy, and rollback plan are explicit.

surfaces.label: Data And Backend MCPs
surfaces.activationRule: Use when a mission explicitly requires schema, database, auth, or backend inspection.

surfaces.label: Observability And Security MCPs
surfaces.activationRule: Use for vulnerability, reliability, incident, or runtime diagnostics missions.

surfaces.label: Product And Collaboration Connectors
surfaces.activationRule: Use when the mission requires external planning, handoff, communication, or workspace context.
guardrails: separate private context from repo state

surfaces.label: Business And Payment Connectors
surfaces.activationRule: Use only for explicit business, CRM, payment, or go-to-market missions.
guardrails: no live financial action without explicit confirmation
